notes_for_editor: Thin record. The FFLA list row is the only source that says anything about this tower, and the Forest Lookouts page is a heading with one photo and no caption. Two searches turned up only unrelated house-fire news. The Forest Lookouts page has an uncaptioned photo (uploads/1/5/9/1/1591048/3010051_orig.jpg); we did not open it, check its license, or confirm it shows this tower, so it is not in photos. The DNR context is statewide and the sources do not link it to Tigerton. A Shawano County historical file or DNR tower record could supply the build and removal dates.
